faq.q: What is a titanium lpt blade (gamma-tial)?
faq.a: A titanium lpt blade (gamma-tial) is a precision-machined engine component component used in low-pressure turbine blade, gamma-tial intermetallic. Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium lpt blade (gamma-tial)?
faq.a: Titanium LPT Blade (Gamma-TiAl) is designed for low-pressure turbine blade, gamma-tial intermetallic. The Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium lpt blade (gamma-tial) manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium LPT Blade (Gamma-TiAl) is manufactured using Closed-die forging. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium lpt blade (gamma-tial)?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.

faq.a: Standard lead time: 2-4 weeks depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders available. Contact our team with your drawing and quantity for an accurate delivery quote.
